verdict.rationale: Manufact covers versioning and review for deployed MCP servers. Deployments come from GitHub, so changes are versioned in Git. The deployment history records the branch and commit of every deploy, and per-branch preview environments with their own MCP URLs let you test changes before merging, backed by publish checklists. Rollback is not documented; the closest options are triggering a deploy of a chosen branch or changing which branch serves production, which amount to Git-level workarounds. Missing for 10: an explicit one-click rollback or redeploy of a prior deployment, a documented diff/approval review workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration.
